title: The Effect of GLP-1 on Postprandial Glucagon Secretion Independent of The Gastric Emptying Rate
brief_summary: Aim: To investigate the glucagonostatic effect of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) independent of the gastric emptying rate.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 Diabetes
* \>18 years
* No residual beta-cell function (stimulated C-peptide \< 60 pmol)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pancreatitis
* gastroparesis
* history of alcohol and/or drug abuse
* pregnancy and lactation
* other medical or psychological condition that made the patient unsuitable for study participation according to the investigators´ assessment
* contraindications to gastroscopy
* cancer (unless in complete remission \> five years)
